name: CI compilation-cache warm set lag — repository busy-skipped past two populate intervals
description: Fires per repository when ci-cache-gauges.sh emits warm-set lag above two warm-cache-populate intervals and at least two consecutive admitted-job busy skips. The datapoint is precomputed because a Honeycomb trigger has one calculation. Fields: repository, warm-set lag, consecutive skipped-busy count. Emitter: ci-runner/observability/ci-cache-gauges.sh. Receiver: host otel-collector -> livespec metrics. Owner: livespec-dev-tooling-uyevam. Runbook: inspect /var/lib/rancher/k3s/storage/.warm/populate-manifest.json, then kubectl -n ci-warm-cache get jobs and logs for warm-cache-populate; leave the admitted-job guardrail in place.
